feeds.title: Design Mom
feeds.description: Covering the intersection of design and motherhood. A blog by Gabrielle Blair, a designer and mother of six. Design Mom helps women across the globe stay well-informed, manage their home life and their work life gracefully, to learn new things daily. It is a place for captivating, eye-opening, mind-expanding discussions.

feeds.title: La Jolla Mom Blog
feeds.description: I'm Katie. I write La Jolla Mom. La Jolla Mom shares the best tips for San Diego vacation planning, luxury hotel perks, travel worldwide, theme park ticket discounts, & much more. I recap our trips and favorite places around the globe. I also talk about our favorite airlines, airport lounges, and gear. My information will help you plan and spend less on traveling.

feeds.title: Beauty Brite
feeds.description: Beauty Brite is a family and lifestyle blog offering stories and experiences from a variety of women and moms!

feeds.title: MoodyDose
feeds.description: A mother and lover of all things practical. My blog covers motherhood by exploring all areas of life. Our tips and tricks help the large community to do more in less time so they can spend time enjoying happy, healthy families.

feeds.title: Don't Mess with Mama
feeds.description: I'm Tracey Black, founder, and CEO of Don't Mess with Mama. I have a background in health care, publishing, research, nutrition, and wellness. DontMesswithMama.com is an online resource for moms and families who want to take a step towards natural wellness. You'll find gluten-free recipes, authentic food recipes, natural remedies, DIY tutorials, and tips to help you live a more natural lifestyle.

feeds.title: The Sunny Side Up Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Erin. Welcome to Sunny Side Up where I share my obsession with organization and my love for home decor and fashion!

feeds.title: MomsLA
feeds.description: We love Los Angeles and think it's a great place to raise our children. Our job is to help you find all the best things to do in Los Angeles - with kids and sometimes without them!We know you're busy raising a family and living the SoCal life. So relax and let us deliver you the info you want - so you can have fun!

feeds.title: BoredMom
feeds.description: BoredMom.com, managed by Meg, offers a mix of healthy recipes, lifestyle tips, travel guides, and creative living ideas. The site emphasizes plant-based eating, sustainable living, and STEM education. Meg combines her background in dietetics with her passion for eco-friendly practices to provide nutritious recipes, party planning ideas, and wellness tips. The blog also features product reviews and travel insights, aiming to inspire and educate readers on living a balanced, creative, and health-conscious life.

feeds.title: The Cool Mom Co.
feeds.description: Bringing the cool back to motherhood, parenting, recipes for kids, trips and travels and more. Elizabeth is the author behind the blog.

feeds.title: Motherhood in Hollywood
feeds.description: Podcast and website featuring fun Entertainment and Parenting topics and the Inside Scoop on the latest films, TV shows and products for your family.

feeds.title: Chrissy Powers Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Chrissy, a therapist, coach, and eternal optimist. I empower others to step into their passion. Here I write about relationships, motherhood, home, style, and life. My motive is to encourage others to live their fullest life through unfreezing patterns of trauma, fear, and shame.

feeds.title: Natural Parent Guide
feeds.description: Hello, I'm L. E. Mastilock. I am a lover of food, family, and nature. I encourage parents to live a green, healthy lifestyle and have fun learning together. I am a published author and multi media artist, homeschooling my kids in the beautiful CA mountains.

feeds.title: loveerickacastanos
feeds.description: A mom of two sharing a snippet of our life. Spreading as much kindness and love while creating some lifestyle content.

feeds.title: Mama Smiles
feeds.description: At Mama Smiles Joyful Parenting, you'll find educational activities, parenting tips, crafts, and family travel inspiration.

feeds.title: Posh in Progress
feeds.description: Posh in Progress is a Top LA Blog and Guide to Chic and Sensible Fashion, Food, Travel & Family Fun.

feeds.title: The Stay-at-Home-Mom Survival Guide Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jaimi Erickson. I am glad you stopped by. I love offering you tools that have helped me get my life and family in balance. A complete guide for Stay-at-Home Moms, covering kids' activities, homemaking tips, simple recipes, natural Living, and encouragement for moms to embrace the season of parenting. Authored by Jaimi Erickson.

feeds.title: The Naptime Reviewer
feeds.description: The NapTime Reviewer is a parenting resource site with an emphasis on family travel, practical fashion, product reviews, and modern day parenting advice.

feeds.title: Hewes Family Fun
feeds.description: Hey all, I'm Abby Keen Hewes, a blogger. The reason I started this blog as I got tired of the coupon blogging rat race and decided to initiate a blog to help people with a frugal lifestyle. Hewes Family Fun is the place where you will find posts about fun, family adventures, shopping, research, and more.

feeds.title: Tinseltown Mom
feeds.description: Hello! My name is Tirralan, founder and editor of Tinseltown Mom. I'm also a devoted wife to a talented and loving filmmaker and mom to two adorable sons. Tinseltown Mom focuses on famous mothers in their daily lives: the good, the bad, the happy, and sometimes sad. The goal is to inspire regular Moms who revere well-known Moms, so they can see that we are all alike in many respects.

feeds.title: The Jolly Tomato
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Jeanne Fratello - a writer, reporter, and mom who is on a mission to find great food for kids and to keep parents up to date on the latest nutrition news.

feeds.title: Someday I'll Learn
feeds.description: I'm Chelsea married to my husband, Nate. Nate offers up hands-on fatherhood and a forthright approach to life's challenges. Chelsea adds color with creative how-tos and commentary about rugged living in a modern era. The blog culminates in a he-said-she-said humorous journal that documents our daily exploits.

feeds.title: Lipgloss and Crayons Blog
feeds.description: Carly is a mom, former teacher, educational advocate, behavior specialist, Disney obsessed, and lives in San Diego. Here you will find all her lifestyle posts.

feeds.title: The Parentologist Blog
feeds.description: Hello! I am Dr. Kim and I am The Parentologist! I am first and foremost a wife and a mom. I am also a Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist and Registered Play Therapist. I hope through my professional and personal experience we can collaborate with each other on how to better ourselves and our relationships with our families and our children.

feeds.title: Ali-ish
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Alia, but most people call me Ali. This is my space to document life as a girl mom, wife, fashion obsessor, sometimes traveler, and a little bit of everything in between! Stick around a while!

feeds.title: Mama Knows It All
feeds.description: Hello there! I'm Brandi, a Northern California African-American mom blogger, the mother of a fabulous tween daughter, a soon-to-be kindergartener son, and wife to an outrageously loving husband. Read ideas on parenting, marriage, kid-friendly recipes and crafts, easy homemaking tips, and daily inspiration!

feeds.title: Happiness is Homemade
feeds.description: I'm Heidi, the founder of Happiness is Homemade. I'm a Northern California mom to three boys and wife to my college sweetheart. I love donuts, rainbows, and sharing quick and easy ideas to help make your busy life easier! Browse hundreds of crafts for kids and adults, printables, DIY bath + body products, party games, quick gift ideas, and more at Happiness is Homemade!

feeds.title: Rookie Moms
feeds.description: Rookie Moms is a fantastic resource for women from pregnancy to preschool & beyond. Offering tons of amazing activities for moms and babies alike, including tips from real moms who have been there/ done that, + ultimate guides to breastfeeding, sleeping, gear & more!

feeds.title: Aileen Cooks
feeds.description: Aileen Clark is a lifestyle blogger, bestselling cookbook author, and mom of four living in Northern California. She loves sharing easy and delicious recipes, fun projects, and family-friendly travel.

feeds.title: LittleGrayThread
feeds.description: Blog articles focus on parenting, motherhood, travel, and more. Jenielle is the author behind the blog and a mom herself.

feeds.description: I am Kristin. My expertise is connecting people, sharing my story, enjoying family life, & discovering the next 'hot trend'. That's what makes me happy (also overusing #hashtags & coffee). You can check me out online anytime & at events. Follow my blog to know what's cooking in my day to day life.

feeds.title: San Diego Songbird
feeds.description: I am Julia. This is my life + style blog where I talk about my creative projects, design, women who inspire me, new product launches for my businesses, my home and family, and my love for San Diego and Southern California living.

feeds.title: Elisamar
feeds.description: My name is Elisamar , fashion blogger from Puerto Rico, living in Orange County California.I decided to open this blog in order to share my flair for being able to make (creating) great looks for every occasion, to share tips on how to dress for less, and to basically be great at accessorizing with statement pieces. I love being a mom and a healthy upbringing, this is also a vital part of my blog.

feeds.title: Amy Davidson
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Amy Davidson. With this site, I plan on sharing everything from the newest nail polish color (ladies you know how extremely important this is to my favorite type of baby bottle, to stories of triumphs and failures and beyond. I will be blogging, sharing pictures and experiences, and creating a platform for all of you to interact as well.

feeds.title: Hollywood Mom Blog
feeds.description: HOLLYWOOD MOM BLOG (HMB) was created more than a decade ago to help parents of professional and aspiring child actors navigate parenting their rising stars amidst the unique landscape of the entertainment industry. HMB's mission is to be a positive community, forum, news outlet, and trusted information resource for all matters related to the lives of child actors.

feeds.title: Over The Top Mommy

I grew up in Southern California and continue to love all that this area offers. It is the hub for family entertainment and you can often find me out and about doing something to keep busy.

feeds.title: enjoy it
feeds.description: enJOY it is a craft and lifestyle blog from Elise Blaha Cripe. On this blog page, you can read her small business stories or start with some of her favorite things to write about, DIY home decor & goal-setting. You can also listen to her motivational speech about the power of making bold statements.

feeds.title: Natalie Borton Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Natalie and I'm an entrepreneur. My goal with this blog is to make your life easier, specifically when it comes to personal style. I believe that what we look like is the least interesting thing about us. I'm constantly pursuing more authenticity and intentionality in my life and choices, and I love to share about that, as well as promote body neutrality and self-acceptance overall.

feeds.description: A motherhood and lifestyle blog to Inspire, Encourage and Help other moms especially new moms. first-time mom, working mom, stay at home mom.
